witness-to-heresy.name: Witness to Heresy
witness-to-heresy.requirement: See the Obsession's Aura for a total of 300 seconds.

dream-demon.name: Dream Demon
dream-demon.requirement: Pull Survivors into the Dream World a total of 200 times.

cripple-them-all.name: Cripple Them All
cripple-them-all.requirement: Grab Survivors directly out of Bear Traps a total of 100 times on PC.

not-today.name: Not Today
not-today.requirement: Unhook yourself a total of 50 times.

skilled-huntress.name: Skilled Huntress
skilled-huntress.requirement: Down Survivors with Hatchets from farther than 24 metres.

fleet-of-foot.name: Fleet of Foot
fleet-of-foot.requirement: Help other Survivors by boosting their Movement speed a total of 50 times.

path-to-salvation.name: Path to Salvation
path-to-salvation.requirement: Gain a Health State within 10 seconds of a Generator being completed, 5 times.

bless-you.name: Bless You
bless-you.requirement: Bless Hex Totems a total of 20 times.

survivor-adept.name: Survivor Adepts
survivor-adept.requirement: Escape using only that Survivor's 3 Unique Perks.

killer-adept.name: Killer Adepts
killer-adept.requirement: Achieve a Merciless Victory using only that Killer's 3 Unique Perks.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.requirement: Take a Protection Hit while the Killer is carrying another Survivor a total of 30 times.

heavy-burden.name: Heavy Burden
heavy-burden.requirement: Hit different Survivors a total of 25 times while carrying another Survivor.

multi-tasker.name: Multi-tasker
multi-tasker.requirement: While carrying a Survivor, down another Survivor a total of 30 times.

cutting-out.name: Cutting Out
cutting-out.requirement: Wiggle free from the Killer's Grasp a total of 10 times.

triggered.name: Triggered
triggered.requirement: Cause Survivors to trip Phantasm Traps a total of 300 times on PC.

even-punishment.name: Even Punishment
even-punishment.requirement: Hit all four Survivors at least once after teleporting to Phantasm Traps in a single Trial.

mad-house.name: Mad House
mad-house.requirement: Get all four Survivors to Madness Tier III in the same Trial.

shocking-treatment.name: Shocking Treatment
shocking-treatment.requirement: Hit Survivors with Shock Therapy a total of 500 times.

totally-vulnerable.name: Totally Vulnerable
totally-vulnerable.requirement: Down Marked Survivors a total of 50 times.

triage.name: Triage
triage.requirement: Heal injured Survivors who come to you from far away without travelling far yourself.

resurgence-achievement.name: Resurgence
resurgence-achievement.requirement: Complete healing while at least three Survivors are injured, dying or hooked.

healthy-obsession.name: Healthy Obsession
healthy-obsession.requirement: Heal the Obsession for a total of 10 Health States.

medic.name: Medic
medic.requirement: Heal other Survivors for a total of 100 Health States.

second-act.name: Second Act
second-act.requirement: Recover from the Dying State with help repeatedly.

honour-the-bloodline.name: Honour the Bloodline
honour-the-bloodline.requirement: Reveal the Killer's Aura for 60 seconds in a single Trial.

working-overtime.name: Working Overtime
working-overtime.requirement: Spend 300 seconds repairing Generators in a single Trial.

power-moves.name: Power Moves
power-moves.requirement: Escape after repairing the equivalent of 1 Generator with no Perks equipped, 8 times.

expert-generalist.name: Expert Generalist
expert-generalist.requirement: Escape after repairing the equivalent of 1 Generator with only 2 universal Perks equipped, 8 times.

skilled-generalist.name: Skilled Generalist
skilled-generalist.requirement: Escape after repairing the equivalent of 1 Generator with only 3 universal Perks equipped, 8 times.

item-of-obsession.name: Item of Obsession
item-of-obsession.requirement: As the Obsession, escape last without being hit.

haemophobia.name: Haemophobia
haemophobia.requirement: Escape Disturbed Ward without being injured.

shock-therapy-map.name: Shock Therapy
shock-therapy-map.requirement: Repair the special Generator on Disturbed Ward and escape.

left-for-dead.name: Left For Dead
left-for-dead.requirement: As the last Survivor alive, finish the last Generator and escape through an Exit Gate.

hero-of-wallachia.name: Hero of Wallachia
hero-of-wallachia.requirement: Stun the Killer with Pallets while holding a qualifying item.

engineer.name: Engineer
engineer.requirement: Repair 50 different Generators after they have been damaged by the Killer.

under-pressure.name: Under Pressure
under-pressure.requirement: Hit Great Skill Checks while injured.

sorted.name: Sorted
sorted.requirement: Spend more than half of a Trial injured and escape.

a-worthy-opponent.name: A Worthy Opponent
a-worthy-opponent.requirement: Spend 90 seconds in Chase in one Trial.

leapfrog.name: Leapfrog
leapfrog.requirement: Vault Pallets or Windows during Chase repeatedly.

whiffing-to-success.name: Whiffing to Success
whiffing-to-success.requirement: Make the Killer miss an attack before you vault.

close-shave.name: Close Shave
close-shave.requirement: Dodge Basic Attacks or Projectiles from Killers a total of 100 times.

desperate-escape.name: Desperate Escape
desperate-escape.requirement: Perform a Rushed Vault within 3 seconds of getting hit, 15 times.

with-scars-to-show.name: With Scars to Show
with-scars-to-show.requirement: Become injured during a Chase and then escape the Chase repeatedly.

insult-and-injury.name: Insult and Injury
insult-and-injury.requirement: Pallet stun the Killer and escape the Chase repeatedly.

hiding-seeker.name: Hiding Seeker
hiding-seeker.requirement: End Chases by hiding in a Locker repeatedly.

rescue-mission.name: Rescue Mission
rescue-mission.requirement: Rescue Survivors from the Killer's Grasp by stunning the Killer with a Pallet, 5 times.

bloodied-hands.name: Bloodied Hands
bloodied-hands.requirement: Safely unhook Survivors while suffering from Broken, 10 times.

one-more-step.name: One More Step
one-more-step.requirement: Take a hit while protected by Endurance, 10 times.

taking-one-for-the-team.name: Taking One For The Team
taking-one-for-the-team.requirement: Take Protection Hits around recently unhooked Survivors repeatedly.

ever-vigilant.name: Ever Vigilant
ever-vigilant.requirement: After all Generators are repaired, complete Healing actions a total of 20 times.

final-days.name: Final Days
final-days.requirement: Take Protection Hits during the Endgame Collapse.

no-one-left-behind.name: No One Left Behind
no-one-left-behind.requirement: Rescue another Survivor from a Hook after the Exit Gates have been powered.

break-for-it.name: Break For It
break-for-it.requirement: Escape Trials while suffering from Broken.

under-my-dominion.name: Under my Dominion
under-my-dominion.requirement: Hit 15 Survivors with Divine Light from at least 16 metres away.

sacrilege.name: Sacrilege
sacrilege.requirement: Gain Heresy through The Judgment's power interactions.

above-judgment.name: Above Judgment
above-judgment.requirement: Escape Exile without being hit by Seeds of Punishment.

silent-approach.name: Silent Approach
silent-approach.requirement: Grab Survivors from Generator interactions repeatedly.

quick-draw.name: Quick Draw
quick-draw.requirement: Grab Survivors interacting with Totems a total of 10 times.

taste-the-darkness.name: Taste the Darkness
taste-the-darkness.requirement: Interrupt and grab Survivors mid-vault a total of 10 times.

from-the-deep.name: From the Deep
from-the-deep.requirement: Find and grab Survivors hiding inside Lockers a total of 25 times.

fearless-healer.name: Fearless Healer
fearless-healer.requirement: Heal while inside the Basement repeatedly.
